title: Chromatid Arm Separation: an ImageJ/Fiji macro for quantifying sister-chromatid arm separation on metaphase spreads
description: An ImageJ/Fiji macro that measures the separation between sister-chromatid arms on metaphase chromosome spreads. For a user-drawn line scan across a chromosome arm, it fits two fixed-width Gaussians to the intensity profile and reports the distance between their centres, with fit-quality metrics, as per-arm and per-image CSV tables. Keyboard-driven, ROI-Manager based, no external plugins required.
